Script.name: Toggles
Script.script: --Toggle the gagging of chat from main buffer. function GUI.gagChatToggle() if GUI.toggles.gagChat == false then GUI.toggles.gagChat = true cecho("\n[CHAT] Now gagging chat from main buffer.") elseif GUI.toggles.gagChat == true then GUI.toggles.gagChat = false cecho("\n[CHAT] No longer gagging chat from main buffer.") else GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, chatSound = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end end --Toggles whether or not you are shown in the group tab. function GUI.showSelfToggle() if GUI.toggles.includeInGroup == false then GUI.toggles.includeInGroup = true GUI.updateGroup() cecho("\n[GROUP] Now showing self in group display.") elseif GUI.toggles.includeInGroup == true then GUI.toggles.includeInGroup = false GUI.updateGroup() cecho("\n[GROUP] No longer showing self in group display.") else GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, chatSound = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) cecho("\n[GROUP] Now showing self in group display.") end end --Toggle horizontal scroll bar on main window function GUI.horizontalScrollToggle() if GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll == false then GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll = true -- Disable word wrap and enable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 999) if enableHorizontalScrollBar then enableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end cecho("\nHorizontal scrolling enabled on main window.") elseif GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll == true then GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll = false -- Re-enable word wrap and disable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 100) if disableHorizontalScrollBar then disableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end cecho("\nHorizontal scrolling disabled on main window (word wrap enabled).") else GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) -- Re-enable word wrap and disable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 100) if disableHorizontalScrollBar then disableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end cecho("\nHorizontal scrolling disabled on main window (word wrap enabled).") end -- Save the toggle state GUI.saveToggles() end function GUI.loadToggles() --Check for saved .lua. Create if not. GUI.toggles = {} if not io.exists(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua") then GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, chatSound = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) else table.load(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end -- Sync chat sound setting with demonnic.chat.config if GUI.toggles.chatSound and demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config then demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = true end end --Save Toggle Preferences function GUI.saveToggles() table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end --Apply horizontal scroll setting to main window function GUI.applyHorizontalScrollSetting() local enabled = GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll or false if enabled then -- Disable word wrap and enable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 999) if enableHorizontalScrollBar then enableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end else -- Re-enable word wrap and disable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 100) if disableHorizontalScrollBar then disableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end end end function GUI.applyPreferencesAfterLoad() return GUI.setOwnedTimer("preferences.applyAfterLoad", 2, function() GUI.applyHorizontalScrollSetting() if GUI.Sound and type(GUI.Sound.syncLegacyChat) == "function" then GUI.Sound.syncLegacyChat() elseif GUI.toggles.chatSound and demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config then demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = true end end) end -- Stop runtime resources that can outlive their current UI state. Anonymous -- handlers are retained here because sysExitEvent is only closing the profile; -- package uninstall uses GUI.cleanupPackageResources() below. function GUI.cleanup() if GUI.Sound and type(GUI.Sound.stopAll) == "function" then GUI.Sound.stopAll() end if demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.stopBlinking then demonnic.chat:stopBlinking() end local timersCanceled = GUI.cancelAllOwnedTimers() GUI.castConsoleTimer = nil GUI.initCallPending = false GUI.msdpReportRequestPending = false GUI.refreshCallsPending = {} if map and map.maplineTrig then if exists(map.maplineTrig, "trigger") ~= 0 then pcall(killTrigger, map.maplineTrig) end map.maplineTrig = nil end GUI.saveToggles() return {timers = timersCanceled} end function GUI.cleanupPackageResources() local cleaned = GUI.cleanup() cleaned.guiHandlers = type(GUI.unregisterEventHandlers) == "function" and GUI.unregisterEventHandlers() or 0 cleaned.mapperHandlers = map and type(map.unregisterFileScopeHandlers) == "function" and map.unregisterFileScopeHandlers() or 0 cleaned.aliases = 0 if map and type(map.aliases) == "table" then for name, aliasId in pairs(map.aliases) do if aliasId and type(killAlias) == "function" then local ok = pcall(killAlias, aliasId) if ok then cleaned.aliases = cleaned.aliases + 1 end end map.aliases[name] = nil end end -- Remove lifecycle handlers last because this function is itself called by -- the owned sysUninstallPackage handler. cleaned.lifecycleHandlers = type(GUI.unregisterLifecycleHandlers) == "function" and GUI.unregisterLifecycleHandlers() or 0 return cleaned end
